results.title: Sedgwick County Voter Districts
results.description: Election layer is a conflation of all electable districts within Sedgwick County that all other districts are derived from. Primary attributes include Precinct, City Code, CouDistNO, BOCCDistNO, SenDistNO, etc...

results.name: Sedgwick_County_City_Limits
results.title: Sedgwick County City Limits
results.description: The City Annex contains polygon features representing the boundaries of individual annexations within Sedgwick County.
results.snippet: The city Annex layer is used to track individual annexations and servers as a source layer for several derivatives. The layer also supports several GIS applications for which City name is associated with other attributes, such as address, taxing unit, election district, 911 dispatch zones, and zoning districts , etc.. The layer is also used for general mapping and is displayed in almost all mapping applications.
